description_zh: 本接口用于查询频道概览中的用户数据
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-channel-user-metrics --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChannelUserMetrics

parameters.help_en: The UNIX timestamp indicating when the channel was created. Data from the last 30 days is supported. The timestamp is expressed in seconds.
parameters.help_zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
The UNIX timestamp indicating when the channel was released, in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
If the provided channel release timestamp exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned.
parameters.help_zh:
释放频道的时间戳，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

Type.description_en:
Metric type. Valid values:
ALL_NUM: User count within a unit of time.
PUB_NUM: Publisher user count within a unit of time.
SUB_NUM: Subscriber user count within a unit of time.
JOIN_FAIL_NUM: User count with abnormal channel join events within a unit of time.
BAD_EXP_NUM: User count with abnormal communication experience within a unit of time
Type.description_zh:
指标类型。取值：
ALL_NUM：单位时间内的用户数量。
PUB_NUM：单位时间内发布端的用户数量。
SUB_NUM：单位时间内订阅端的用户数量。
JOIN_FAIL_NUM：单位时间内加入频道异常的用户数量。
BAD_EXP_NUM：单位时间内通信体验异常的用户数量
Type.title_en: 指标类型，取值：ALL_NUM：累计用户数量。PUB_NUM：累计发布用户数量。SUB_NUM：累计订阅用户数量。JOIN_FAIL_NUM：累计加入频道异常用户数量。BAD_EXP_NUM：累计通信体验异常用户。
